answer_1.quote: we propose a multi-modal seq2set (MMS2S) approach to model both the modality and label dependence simultaneously... by finding the most likely emotion label set.

answer_2.quote: we employ three evaluation metrics to measure the performances of different approaches to multi-modal multi-label emotion detection, i.e., multi-label Accuracy (Acc), Hamming Loss (HL) and micro F 1 measure (F 1 ).
